transitionStructuredPlan.summary: Transitioning from Cashier to Pharmacy Technician in Ontario, Canada requires completing a two-year pharmacy technician college program or a related pharmaceutics program with supervised practical training, followed by licensing with the Ontario College of Pharmacists. The path is structured and regulated, with a timeline of approximately 13 to 19 months. Key skills include technical checks, medication preparation, and use of Excel in workflows. Credentials needed include formal education and regional certification. Starting from zero involves confirming program and licensing requirements and building foundational knowledge through short daily study blocks.

Licensing and certification by the Ontario College of Pharmacists (OCP) or relevant provincial regulator
required_experience: Perform final technical check of products as per departmental process and OCP standards
Prepare daily cartfill medications and complete associated documentation
Experience in pharmacy distributive activities and parenteral drug preparation may be considered
